brief.t: START HERE: Open Polo's October 20 exam-fee invoice, verify whether it was paid, and send Erik the receipt or a payment decision today.

ACT NOW 1: Release container EMCU8614105. Erik's October 20 payment deadline is 2 calendar days past; no newer payment or release confirmation was found. Send: Erik, I am checking the exam fee payment now and will confirm the receipt or payment timing today; please confirm release and earliest pickup once accounting clears it.

ACT NOW 2: Reconcile TALOVA's FBA shipments. Marcello has waited 2 calendar days on new labels and shipments showing open, and 14 days since his original replenishment request. A USPS pickup of 60 pieces yesterday is not proof these FBA shipments shipped. Send: Marcello, I am matching the open shipments to our inventory and carrier scans now and will send confirmed ship dates and tracking today.

ACT NOW 3: Close the ingredient gaps with Michael and Aaron, 3 calendar days after their October 19 request. Agua approval and Silgreen G landed timing remain unverified; Cheirosa 62 was ordered yesterday, not received. Magnolia's delivery notice lists only 8 oz against the requested 0.95 kg; verify identity and usable quantity before treating the hold as cleared. Send: Michael, I am closing the Agua decision and Silgreen delivery timing today; Cheirosa 62 is ordered, and I need Aaron to confirm the Magnolia identity and usable quantity against the 0.95 kg requirement.

next: Recommendation: Verify Polo payment first, reconcile TALOVA second, then close the ingredient decisions without assuming ordered or carrier-delivered means available to Production.
Displaced: Roon Body's 1,500-unit timeline request is 6 calendar days old; today's documented ingredient shortages take the third slot because they directly block lab or production readiness.

Scheduled: 17 active CRM tasks, including 15 past their displayed due dates, remain below these three priorities. Nearest dated task is October 22: give Sam technical feasibility inputs for Ashley's haircare request; customer pricing stays with Sam. Counts describe this CRM task view, not the entire operational backlog.
Noise: 30 of 42 new Outlook messages were below the operational review cutoff.

Sources: Outlook inbox and Sent Items reviewed; Aidan's named CRM session is now signed in and tasks and purchase orders were read. WhatsApp browser session signed out. Purchasing and Email status requests were routed; no matching fresh reply was available at publication. Older unread-mail search was capped at 50, so older backlog coverage is partial.

TALOVA's new labels and open shipments have no verified matched dispatch or tracking update.
